source_evidence: In some cases, fees are negotiable, so you can talk to your broker about reducing them. Brokers, like any business, compete for customers on the basis of price and services.
question: Misconception: Brokerage fees are fixed, so there is no point in negotiating them or comparing brokers.
answer: Some fees may be negotiable, and brokers compete for customers on price and services. You can ask your broker about reducing fees and compare the costs and services offered by other brokers. Before moving firms, consider any taxes or fees that could result from closing or transferring your account.
